features.q: The ancients carved this truth onto the stone rim of the well: total trust unlocks the world’s abundance, and equitable return keeps the magic alive.
The wandering mists continued to whisper, yet their sacred pact remained unbroken.
Though turbulent currents and drifting mists sometimes nudged the gems off course, causing slight ripples in the observed count, Ronen never hesitated.
Orin placed unwavering faith in the covenant.
Though shifting atmospheric winds often blurred the flight of the orbs—whispering illusions of altered numbers—Orin placed unwavering faith in the covenant.
Honoring the primordial covenant of balance, she carefully halved the fifteen blossoms, returning an exact equal share back across the vast divide.
Though spectral crosswinds frequently drifted through the chasm—sometimes blurring the sight of the falling seeds with phantom ripples—Sylas never held back.
With unwavering faith in their sacred covenant, he released his full measure of five embers into the sky.
Though shifting tempest winds constantly swirled through the gorge, creating shimmering mirages that slightly blurred the perceived count of the falling embers, Corin never yielded to doubt.
The fickle winds could never sever their sacred covenant.
Though turbulent celestial winds frequently swirled between the peaks, casting mirages that subtly distorted the true count of the falling pearls, Aric never surrendered to doubt.
Grounded in unwavering faith in their sacred covenant, she cast her full measure of five embers into the sky without reservation.
Though phantom crosswinds frequently swirled through the rift, casting deceptive ripples that subtly blurred the true count of the falling embers, Theresa never faltered.
she adhered strictly to the law of sacred balance.
Though wandering atmospheric winds constantly swept through the gorge, creating shimmering mirages that slightly distorted the apparent count of the falling prisms, Valen never succumbed to doubt.
she honored the law of righteous equity.

Though turbulent atmospheric gales continuously swept through the chasm, casting flickering illusions that subtly distorted the perceived number of falling gems, Zephyr never surrendered to hesitation.

Though turbulent atmospheric crosswinds constantly danced through the gorge, casting deceptive ripples that subtly distorted the perceived measure of falling prisms, Kael never let hesitation stay his hand.

uncertainties: R2 introduces environmental count noise, but continued full giving does not clearly revise R1’s full-giving/half-return custom.
Noise labels reflect environmental attribution paired with maintained trust; no intentional-misconduct episode is explicitly contrasted.
Warnings that greed would destroy abundance are borderline hypothetical alternatives; conservatively treated as causal explanations rather than explicit scenario deliberations.
Full giving and half return specify allocations, not decision thresholds. Prosperity conditions describe outcomes, not branching prescriptions.
